title: Holding the door for someone way too far away

narrator.style: clear, clean, crisp studio voice with precise articulation, smooth, not breathy, not raspy; dry deadpan narrator, slightly unimpressed, natural pace

theo.style: clear, clean voice, not breathy, not raspy; cheeky young guy roasting his friend, trying not to laugh

lines.say: You're holding the door for someone a whole zip code away.
Now it's a contract. Nobody can back out.
So they do the fake thank-you jog.
Bro. You look like a doorman nobody tips. Absolute clown.
They finally arrive and go: oh sorry, I wasn't going in.
You held that door for absolutely fucking nothing.
A pigeon walks in. Doesn't even say thanks.
Theo walks in too. Also no thanks, the little shit.
And now there's someone behind you. A whole zip code away.

hook: POV: you hold the door way too early
